g.text: Speed layer: live doses, generations and the serving merge

text.tspan: Every live dose is stamped with the open generation G of ops.live_generation inside its insert transaction.
raw.live_dose is unique on (client_id, idempotency_key) and on (person_id, vaccine_code, dose_label).
The API writes raw.live_dose, live.dose_daily and ops.ingest_reject when ingesting, and app.campaign for gestores.
dbt closes generations through ops.close_live_generation() and absorbs raw.live_dose rows up to W.
Dashed arrow: protocol link, no foreign key.
